subject.title: [Bug]: Managed node install can retain invalid Gateway connection settings

question: Should maintainers sponsor a focused core fix for this protected managed-node credential and TLS-retargeting bug now?
rationale: The source bug is clear, but the fix touches credential persistence, systemd env-file serialization, uninstall scrubbing, and TLS pinning behavior on a protected maintainer-labeled issue.

options.title: Sponsor the focused fix
options.body: Proceed with one bounded PR covering password persistence, systemd env-file quoting/uninstall cleanup, and endpoint-retarget TLS reset with regression tests.

options.title: Split the repair
options.body: Track password/env-file handling and TLS retargeting separately if maintainers want smaller security-sensitive review units.

options.title: Defer protected work
options.body: Leave this issue assigned for manual scheduling without queueing ClawSweeper automation.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the focused fix
recommendation.body: Proceed with one bounded PR covering password persistence, systemd env-file quoting/uninstall cleanup, and endpoint-retarget TLS reset with regression tests.

likelyOwner.reason: The issue is assigned to steipete and the central node daemon feature history points to earlier node daemon work by the same owner.
